changes.text: Sleazy Crow: community fork of Senape3000's EvilCrowRF-V2 firmware (based on v1.1.3). Bluetooth name is now SleazyCrow.
Bluetooth no longer drops ~12 s after connecting on Android: incoming commands run on their own task and stable connection parameters are requested.
No boot crash when built with Arduino core 3.3.x (BLE controller memory was freed before NimBLE started).
Toolchain and NimBLE pinned so every build is identical (fixes the 'adc_oneshot.h' compile error).
File uploads: a full queue no longer drops chunks, and missing/out-of-order chunks fail with an error instead of saving a corrupted file.
ProtoPirate decode results show the protocol type name instead of a number.
Boot log prints the firmware name, version and upstream project.
Sleazy Crow app: installs alongside the official EvilCrow RF app; updates come from the Sleazy Crow releases.
Flipper Sub-GHz DB: pick which sections to copy to the SD card instead of the whole database; brute-force folders are opt-in.
Optional 'format SD card first' and an explainer before the download.
Large RAW .sub files are split into smaller pieces so they upload reliably (playback is identical).
Uploads no longer report false failures ('Null check operator' race).
Uploads about 40x faster; live time-remaining estimate.
Transmit button toggles continuous transmission on/off.
Brute force: US/EU frequency choice and timing (te) override.
File preview loads only when requested, so opening files is instant.
